answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized generalization capabilities and interaction methods, driving the application of human-AI collaboration in real-world tasks.
tasks: Other:real-time simultaneous human-AI collaboration in a cooking game
answer_1.outputs: The agent generates macro actions (e.g., prepare ingredients, assemble burgers, serve food) through code-as-policy outputs in a collaborative cooking environment.

answer_2.quote: Metrics we used in experiments include Atom Action Occupy, Failure Missed, Failure Wrong Serve, Score Efficiency, Agent Contribution Rate, the total game score, and latency in second.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate DPT-Agent's capabilities of collaborating with humans, we conduct experiments with 71 university students.
answer_4.guideline: Participants played two games each with four different agents in random order and were asked to complete cooperative cooking tasks. Subjective human preferences were collected.
